description: Manages and provides access to various lookup values and reference data such as currencies, countries, application types, and simplified lists of partners, contacts, and users.

endpoints.name: GetCurrencies
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available currencies.
example_uses: How can I get a list of all supported currencies?
I need to see all currency options.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need a comprehensive list of all currencies supported by the system, for display or selection purposes.

endpoints.name: GetEligibleEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of entities that are eligible for certain operations or classifications.
example_uses: Can you provide the list of eligible organizations?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of entities that meet specific eligibility criteria within the system.

endpoints.name: GetCountries
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all countries.
example_uses: I need a list of countries for a dropdown.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a complete list of countries, typically for geographical selection or reference.

endpoints.name: GetApplicationTypes
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all defined application types.
example_uses: What are the different application types?
Show me the types of applications.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of various application types, useful for categorization or filtering.

endpoints.name: GetPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a simplified list of all partners. For detailed partner information or search, use the dedicated Partner entity endpoints.
example_uses: Show me a quick list of partners.
I need a basic list of partner names.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint for a high-level overview or selection of partners when detailed information is not required. For comprehensive partner management, refer to the 'Partner' entity.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationUnits
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all organizational units within the system.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a list of all organizational units, typically for hierarchical display or assignment.

endpoints.name: GetContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a simplified list of all contacts. For detailed contact information or search, use the dedicated Contact entity endpoints.
example_uses: Show me a quick list of contacts.
I need a basic list of contact names.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint for a high-level overview or selection of contacts when detailed information is not required. For comprehensive contact management, refer to the 'Contact' entity.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all users registered in the system.
example_uses: Show me who the users are.
I need a list of all registered accounts.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a list of all system users, typically for administrative purposes or user assignment.

endpoints.name: GetGeminiModels
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available Gemini AI models.
example_uses: Show me the supported Gemini versions.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of available Gemini AI models, useful for configuring AI-powered features.
